messages:
pagerduty-bot: 🔔 PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-0427 - elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway (us-west-2). Trigger: 5xx > 1.5% over 5m. Paging eng-sre on-call: @alex

alex: ack. i'm oncall. joining now. can someone paste the top-level graphs?

maria: pasting quick snapshot — error rate spike started ~12:18 UTC and correlates with increased 429s from quota-service at 12:20.

maria: stack snippet:
```
2026-03-14T12:20:11Z WARN quota-service: rate limit exceeded tenant=t-1234 limit=100/s burst=0
2026-03-14T12:20:13Z ERROR gateway: upstream=quota-service status=429 handling=reject
2026-03-14T12:20:18Z ERROR gateway: upstream=inference-pool status=502 reason=upstream-timeout
```

samir: i rolled a quota config change at 12:19 UTC (release-3.4.2) to tighten per-tenant burst to 0 for one-off experiment. that change propagated to prod canaries then global.

alex: ok that matches. so quota-service returning 429s -> gateway retries -> backend under pressure -> 502/504s. we're seeing a cascade. priority: stop the quoterollout and restore previous burst.

beth: customer-impact: tenant t-1234, t-6789 and a handful of small tenants saw elevated errors. internal dashboard shows affected requests hitting model-fallback at 12:22. i'm drafting a proactive message for top customers.

ira: paging notes: oncall handoff in 10m, but alex is landing this. i'll stay as scribe for timeline.

samir: running rollback now:
```bash
kubectl -n infra set image deploy/quota-service quota-service=quota-service:3.4.1
kubectl rollout status deploy/quota-service -n infra
```

deploy-bot: @samir started rollout: quota-service -> release-3.4.1 (rollout id r-5043). progress: 1/5 pods ready.

maria: validating traffic routing — gateway still seeing a backlog of queued requests; start trimming retries for 429s to reduce pressure. patching gateway retry policy to max_retries=1 for now.

alex: doing a hotpatch on gateway:
```yaml
# patch-retry.yaml
spec:
  retry_policy:
    max_retries: 1
    retry_on: 5xx, gateway-error
```

alex: applied patch. this should reduce retry storms and let quota-service recover after rollback.

beth: quick note on severity: we're at SEV2 due to multiple customers impacted and increased error rate. will escalate to SEV1 if error rate stays >2% for next 15m.

deploy-bot: rollout status: quota-service rollout complete, 5/5 pods ready (rollout id r-5043).

samir: rollback confirmed. canary and global back to 3.4.1. monitoring shows 429s falling back to baseline within 2m.

maria: gateway 5xxs trending down now. rolling averages: 5xx 5m window 0.9% -> 0.3% after patches.

alex: good. next steps: 1) sustain monitoring for 30m, 2) keep retry cap in place for 1h, 3) asses if we need circuit-breaker on per-tenant basis.

beth: customer comms: sent emails to t-1234 and t-6789, flagged for follow-up. customer support to open tickets and attach logs.

ira: timeline notes saved. creating incident record INC-2026-0427 with initial mitigation steps and owners.

samir: root cause (short): aggressive quota config rolled without burst default -> 429s -> retry amplification -> backend saturation -> 5xx cascade.

alex: action items assigned:
- samir: add safer rollout guard to quota-service (automated slow rollout + canary quota checks).
- maria: add synthetic test that covers quota edge cases and retry behavior before prod rollout.
- beth: coordinate customer outreach and add follow-up with support.
- ira: own postmortem doc and schedule RCA meeting.

maria: quick mitigation note: we'll also add a soft-default burst for all tenants (e.g., burst=20) and expose a circuit-breaker metric to SLO dashboards.

beth: are there any lingering hotspots? i'm still seeing intermittent 502s for a tiny fraction of requests (0.05%).

alex: that's expected during cooldown; keep an eye. if that doesn't converge in 20m we escalate.

ira: switching to post-incident wrap: who will draft the timeline for the postmortem? alex + samir + maria?

alex: i'll take timeline + mitigation writeup. samir you add rollout guard plan. maria add tests and monitoring asks.

beth: thanks everyone. marking incident as resolved for customer-facing comms at 12:58 UTC but keeping thread open until follow-ups complete. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-0427 status: mitigated by rollback and gateway retry cap. incident auto-notes updated.

ira: assigning owners in doc and scheduling RCA for tomorrow 15:00 UTC. closing handoff to eng-sre follow-up queue.

alex: nice work. postmortem checklist: timeline, cause, remediation, actions, and owner + due dates. i'll start PR for the rollout guard tomorrow.

samir: will add feature flag + canary gating to deployment pipeline and require canary quota smoke test.

beth: i'll update support ticket statuses and attach initial log excerpts.

ira: thread summary appended to incident record. closing slack thread in 2h unless blockers show up.

alex: thanks all.
